title: Weak polyhedral approximation theorem (Simon 6.2)
statement: For all m, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≥ 1, every open U ⊆ ℝ^{m+1+ℓ} and every integer multiplicity T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ and M_W(∂T) < ∞ for all W ⊂⊂ U, there are ρ : ℕ → (0,∞) antitone with ρ_k → 0, integer coefficients β_k on the faces 𝓛_{m+1}(ρ_k) and currents P_k ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with IsLatticeChain ρ_k β_k P_k for all k and P_k ⇀ T in U.
